G2805.def:
**κλαυθμός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(κλαίω), [in LXX chiefly for בְּכִי ;]
crying, weeping, [[Act.20.37|Act.20:37]] κ. καὶ ὀδυρμός, [[Mat.2.18|Mat.2:18]] (LXX); ὁ κ. καὶ ὁ βρυγμός, [[Mat.8.12; 13.42, 50; 22.13; 24.51; 25.30|Mat.8:12 13:42, 50 22:13 24:51 25:30]], [[Luk.13.28|Luk.13:28]].†
(AS)

G2889.def:
**κόσμος**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: [[Gen.2.1|Gen.2:1]], [[Deu.4.19; 17.3|Deu.4:19 17:3]], [[Isa.24.21; 40.26|Isa.24:21 40:26]] (צבא), [[Exo.33.5|Exo.33:5]], 6 [[Jer.2.32; 4.30|Jer.2:32 4:30]], [[Ezk.7.20; 16.11; 23.40|Eze.7:20 16:11 23:40]] (עֲדִי), [[Isa.61.10|Isa.61:10]] (כְּלִי), al., [[Wis.2.24|Wis.2:24]] and freq., [[Sir.6.30|Sir.6:30]], al ;]
1. **order** (Hom., Plat., al.).
2. **ornament, adornment**, esp. of women (Hom., al.): [[1Pe.3.3|1Pe.3:3]]
3. Later, the **world** or **universe**, **as an ordered system **(Plat., al.): [[Act.17.24|Act.17:24]], [[Rom.4.13|Rom.4:13]], [[1Co.3.22|1Co.3:22]], [[Php.2.15|Php.2:15]], [[Heb.4.3|Heb.4:3]], al.
4. In late writers only, **the world**, i.e. **the earth** (= ἡ οἰκουμένη, cf. [[Mat.4.8|Mat.4:8]] with [[Luk.4.5|Luk.4:5]]): [[Mat.4.8|Mat.4:8]], Mrk.16:[15], [[Col.2.20|Col.2:20]], [[1Ti.6.7|1Ti.6:7]], al.; hence by meton.,
(a) **of the human inhabitants of the world**: [[Mat.5.14; 15.38|Mat.5:14 15:38]], [[Mrk.14.9|Mrk.14:9]], [[Jhn.1.10; 4.42; 12.47|Jhn.1:10 4:42 12:47]], [[Rom.3.6|Rom.3:6]], [[1Co.4.13|1Co.4:13]], [[2Co.5.19|2Co.5:19]], [[2Pe.2.5|2Pe.2:5]], al.;
(b) **of worldly affairs or possessions**: [[Mat.16.26|Mat.16:26]], [[Mrk.8.36|Mrk.8:36]], [[Luk.9.25|Luk.9:25]], [[1Co.7.31|1Co.7:31]], [[1Jn.2.16|1Jn.2:16]], al.;
(with) **in ethical sense, of the ungodly**: [[Jhn.7.7; 14.17, 27|Jhn.7:7 14:17, 27]] [[1Co.1.21|1Co.1:21]], [[Jas.1.27|Jas.1:27]], [[1Jn.4.4|1Jn.4:4]], al.;
(d) metaphorically: ὁ κ. τῆς ἀδικίας, [[Jas.3.6|Jas.3:6]]
_SYN._: αἰών, which see (cf . also Dalman, _Words_, 162ff.; Tr., _Syn._, §lix; Westc., additional note on [[Jhn.1.10|Jhn.1:10]] _DB_, iv, 938ff.). (AS)

G2816.def:
**κληρονομέω**, -ῶ
(κληρονόμος) [in LXX chiefly for יָרַשׁ, also for נָחַל, etc. ;]
1. to receive by lot.
2. **to inherit **(in cl., usually with genitive of thing(s)): absol., [[Gal.4.30|Gal.4:30]] (LXX); in general, to possess oneself of, receive as one's own, obtain (as [[Deu.4.5|Deu.4:5]], al., cf. [[Psa.25.3|Psa.25:3]], [[Isa.61.7|Isa.61:7]]): with accusative of thing(s) (as generally in late Gk., see M, _Pr._, 65), of the Messianic Kingdom (cf. [[Psa.37.11|Psa.37:11]], [[Sir.4.13; 37.26|Sir.4:13 37:26]], and see Dalman, _Words_, 125 ff.) and its bless­ings and privileges, τ. γῆν, [[Mat.5.5|Mat.5:5]] (cf. LXX); τ. βασιλείαν, β. θεοῦ, [[Mat.25.34|Mat.25:34]], [[1Co.6.9-10; 15.50|1Co.6:9-10 15:50]], [[Gal.5.21|Gal.5:21]]; ζωὴν αἰώνιον, [[Mat.19.29|Mat.19:29]], [[Mrk.10.17|Mrk.10:17]], [[Luk.10.25; 18.18|Luk.10:25 18:18]]; σωτηρίαν, [[Heb.1.14|Heb.1:14]] τ. ἐπαγγελίας, [[Heb.6.12|Heb.6:12]] ἀφθαρσίαν, [[1Co.15.50|1Co.15:50]] ὄνομα, [[Heb.1.4|Heb.1:4]] τ. εὐλογίαν, [[Heb.12.17|Heb.12:17]], [[1Pe.3.9|1Pe.3:9]]; ταῦτα, [[Rev.21.7|Rev.21:7]] (cf. κατα-κληρονομέω).†
(AS)

G2835.def:
**κοδράντης**, -ου, ὁ (Lat. quadrans, the fourth part of an as),
**a quadrans **(AV, farthing): [[Mat.5.26|Mat.5:26]], [[Mrk.12.42|Mrk.12:42]].†
(AS)

G2808.def:
**κλείω **
[in LXX chiefly for סָגַר ;]
**to shut**: θύραν, [[Mat.6.6|Mat.6:6]] τ. ἄβυσσον, [[Rev.20.3|Rev.20:3]] pass., θύρα, [[Mat.25.10|Mat.25:10]], [[Luk.11.7|Luk.11:7]] (pl.), [[Jhn.20.19, 26|Jhn.20:19, 26]], [[Act.21.30|Act.21:30]]; δεσμωτήριον, [[Act.5.23|Act.5:23]] πυλῶνες, [[Rev.21.25|Rev.21:25]] Metaphorical, τ. οὐρανόν, [[Luk.4.25|Luk.4:25]], [[Rom.11.6|Rom.11:6]]; τ. σπλάγχνα, [[1Jn.3.17|1Jn.3:17]] τ. βασιλείαν, [[Mat.23.14|Mat.23:14]] id. absol., [[Rev.3.7|Rev.3:7]] τ. θύραν, [[Rev.3.8|Rev.3:8]] (cf. ἀπο-, ἐκ-, κατα-, συν-κλείω.) †
(AS)

G2812.def:
**κλέπτης**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for גַּנָּב ;]
**a thief**: [[Mat.6.19-20; 24.43|Mat.6:19-20 24:43]], [[Luk.12.33, 39|Luk.12:33, 39]], [[Jhn.10.1, 10; 12.6|Jhn.10:1, 10 12:6]], [[1Co.6.10|1Co.6:10]], [[1Pe.4.15|1Pe.4:15]]. Fig., ὡς κ. ἐν νυκτί, [[1Th.5.2; 5.4|1Th.5:2 5:4]] (κλέπτας, WH, txt., R, mg.; see Lft., _Notes_, 73; but cf. also M, _Th._, l.with), [[2Pe.3.10|2Pe.3:10]], [[Rev.3.3; 16.15|Rev.3:3 16:15]]. Metaphorical, of false teachers, [[Jhn.10.8|Jhn.10:8]]†
_SYN._: λῃστής, a robber, a brigand who plunders, openly, with violence; κ. is a thief who steals in secret, by fraud and cunning (Tr., _Syn._, § xliv) (AS)

G2872.def:
**κοπιάω**, -ῶ
(κόπος), [in LXX chiefly for יָגַע ;]
1. (as in cl.) to grow weary: [[Mat.11.28|Mat.11:28]], [[Jhn.4.6|Jhn.4:6]], [[Rev.2.3|Rev.2:3]] (cf. [[Isa.40.31|Isa.40:31]]).
2. **Hence, in LXX and NT, to work with effort, to toil**: absol., [[Mat.6.23|Mat.6:23]], [[Luk.5.5; 12.27|Luk.5:5 12:27]], [[Jhn.4.38|Jhn.4:38]], [[Act.20.35|Act.20:35]], [[1Co.4.12|1Co.4:12]], [[Eph.4.28|Eph.4:28]], [[2Ti.2.5|2Ti.2:5]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[Jhn.4.38|Jhn.4:38]] frequently in Paul. Epp., of ministerial labour: [[1Co.15.10; 16.16|1Co.15:10 16:16]]; before ἐν, [[Rom.16.12|Rom.16:12]], [[1Th.5.12|1Th.5:12]] (see M, _Th._, in l), [[1Ti.5.17|1Ti.5:17]] εἰς, [[Rom.16.6|Rom.16:6]], [[Gal.4.11|Gal.4:11]], [[Php.2.16|Php.2:16]], [[Col.1.29|Col.1:29]], [[1Ti.4.10|1Ti.4:10]].†
(AS)

G2823.def:
**κλίβανος**, -ον, ό
(Att.., κρίβ-, but κλ- in Ion., Hdt., ii, 92), [in LXX for תַּנּוּר, [[Gen.15.17|Gen.15:17]], [[Hos.7.4|Hos.7:4]], 6 al. ;]
1. in cl., a clibanus, cribanus, an earthen vessel for baking bread.
2. In LXX and NT, a furnace (cf. MM, _Exp._, xv), **an oven**: [[Mat.6.30|Mat.6:30]], [[Luk.12.28|Luk.12:28]].†
(AS)

G2827.def:
**κλίνω **
[in LXX chiefly for נָטָה ;]
1. **to make to bend, to bow**: τ. κεφαλήν (of one dying), [[Jhn.19.30|Jhn.19:30]] τ. πρόσωτον (of terrified persons), [[Luk.24.5|Luk.24:5]]
2. **to make to lean, to rest**: τ. κεφαλήν (in sleep), [[Mat.8.20|Mat.8:20]], [[Luk.9.58|Luk.9:58]].
3. As in Hom., of soldiers, to turn (to flight), παρεμβολάς, [[Heb.11.34|Heb.11:34]]
4. In late Gk. (as mid, in cl.), **to decline**: intrans., ἡ ἡμέρα, [[Luk.9.12; 24.29|Luk.9:12 24:29]].†
(AS)

G2896.def:
**κράζω **
[in LXX for זָעַק, צָעַק, קָרָא, etc. ;]
in cl. chiefly poët.,
1. prop. onomatop., of the raven, to croak, hence generally, of inartic. cries, **to scream, cry out **(Æsch., al.): [[Mrk.5.5; 9.26; 15.39|Mrk.5:5 9:26 15:39]] (Rec., R, mg.), [[Luk.9.39|Luk.9:39]], al.; of crying for vengeance (cf. [[Gen.4.10|Gen.4:10]]), [[Jas.5.4|Jas.5:4]].
2. to cry, call out with a loud voice: with accusative of thing(s), [[Act.19.32|Act.19:32]] before orat. dir., [[Mrk.10.48|Mrk.10:48]], [[Luk.18.39|Luk.18:39]], al.; (ἐν) φωνῇ μεγάλῃ, [[Mrk.5.7|Mrk.5:7]], [[Rev.14.15|Rev.14:15]], al.; λέγων, [[Mat.8.29|Mat.8:29]], al.; of public teaching, [[Jhn.1.15|Jhn.1:15]], [[Rom.9.27|Rom.9:27]], al.; of importunate prayer (cf. [[Job.35.12|Job.35:12]], [[Psa.3.5|Psa.3:5]], al.), [[Rom.8.15|Rom.8:15]], [[Gal.4.6|Gal.4:6]]; pf. with Pres. sense (vernac.; M, _Pr._, 147), [[Jhn.1.15|Jhn.1:15]]
_SYN._: see: βοάω (AS)

G2899.def:
**κράσπεδον**, -ου, τό
[in LXX: [[Num.15.38-39|Num.15:38-39]] (צִיצִת) [[Deu.22.12|Deu.22:12]], [[Zec.8.23|Zec.8:23]] (כָּנָף)* ;]
1. in cl., an edge, border.
2. In LXX (see supr.) and NT, **a tassel or corner**: [[Mat.9.20; 14.36; 23.5|Mat.9:20 14:36 23:5]], [[Mrk.6.56|Mrk.6:56]], [[Luk.8.44|Luk.8:44]].†
(AS)

G2877.def:
**κοράσιον**, -ου, τό
(dimin. of κόρη), [in LXX chiefly for נַעֲרָה, [[Rut.2.8|Rut.2:8]], al.; in [[Jol.4.3|Joel 4:3]], [[Zec.8.5|Zec.8:5]] for יַלְדָּה ;]
a colloquial word which survives in M_Gr._ (Kennedy, Sourcs, e154), **girl, maiden**: [[Mat.9.24-25; 14.11|Mat.9:24-25 14:11]], [[Mrk.5.41-42; 6.22, 28|Mrk.5:41-42 6:22, 28]].†
(AS)

G2868.def:
**κονιορτός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(κόνις or κονία, dust, ὄρνυμι, to stir up), [in LXX for אָבָק, etc. ;]
in cl., dust stirred up ([[Exo.9.9|Exo.9:9]], [[Isa.5.24|Isa.5:24]]); in NT, **simply dust**: [[Mat.10.14|Mat.10:14]], [[Luk.9.5; 10.11|Luk.9:5 10:11]], [[Act.13.51; 22.23|Act.13:51 22:23]].†
(AS)

G2875.def:
**κόπτω **
[in LXX for כָּרַת, סָפַד, נָכָה hi., etc. ;]
1. to strike, smite.
2. **to cut off**: with accusative of thing(s), before ἀπό, [[Mat.21.8|Mat.21:8]] ἐκ, [[Mrk.11.8|Mrk.11:8]] Mid., **to beat one's breast with grief, to mourn, bewail**: [[Mat.11.17; 24.30|Mat.11:17 24:30]]; with accusative of person(s), [[Luk.8.52; 23.27|Luk.8:52 23:27]]; before ἐπί, with accusative, [[Rev.1.7; 18.9|Rev.1:7 18:9]] (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο-, ἐκ-, ἐν-, κατα-, προ-, προσ-κόπτω).†
_SYN._: θρηνέω, q.v (AS)

G2885.def:
**κοσμέω**, -ῶ
(κόσμος), [in LXX for עָדָה, תָּקַן, etc. ;]
1. **to order, arrange, prepare **(in Hom. esp. of marshalling armies): [[Mat.25.7|Mat.25:7]] (cf. [[Sir.50.9|Sir.50:9]], al.).
2. **to adorn, furnish**: οἶκον, pass., [[Mat.12.44|Mat.12:44]], [[Luk.11.25|Luk.11:25]]; μνημεῖα, [[Mat.23.29|Mat.23:29]] τὸ ἱερόν, pass., [[Luk.21.5|Luk.21:5]] θεμέλιοι, [[Rev.21.19|Rev.21:19]] νύμφην, pass., [[Rev.21.2|Rev.21:2]] ἐαυτάς, before ἐν, [[1Ti.2.9|1Ti.2:9]] Metaphorical, with accusative of person(s), [[1Pe.3.5|1Pe.3:5]] with accusative of thing(s), [[Tit.2.10|Tit.2:10]]†
(AS)

G2894.def:
**κόφινος**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: [[Jdg.6.19|Jdg.6:19]] (סַל), [[Psa.81.6|Psa.81:6]] (דּוּד)* ;]
**a basket, probably of wicker-work, such as were carried by Jews for food**: [[Mat.14.20; 16.9|Mat.14:20 16:9]], [[Mrk.6.43; 8.19; 9.17; 13.8|Mrk.6:43 8:19 9:17 13:8]], [[Jhn.6.13|Jhn.6:13]] (cf. σφυρίς).†
(AS)

G2869.def:
**κοπάζω**
(κόπος), [in LXX: [[Gen.8.1|Gen.8:1]], [[Est.2.1; 7.10|Est.2:1 7:10]] (שָׁכַךְ), [[Rut.1.18|Rut.1:18]], al. (חָדַל), חָדַל), [[Jon.1.11-12|Jon.1.11-12]] (שָׁתַק), al. ;]
**to grow weary**; of the wind (Hdt., Jh., l.with), **to abate, cease raging**: [[Mat.14.32|Mat.14:32]], [[Mrk.4.39; 6.51|Mrk.4:39 6:51]].†
(AS)

G2840.def:
**κοινόω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[4Ma.7.6|4Ma.7:6]] א R* ;]
1. in cl., to make common.
2. In LXX, l.with, and NT (as κοινός, 2), **to make ceremonially unclean, to profane **(= cl., βεληλόω): [[Mat.15.11, 18; 15.20|Mat.15:11, 18 15:20]], [[Mrk.7.15, 18; 7.20, 23|Mrk.7:15, 18 7:20, 23]], [[Act.21.28|Act.21:28]]; pass., [[Heb.9.13|Heb.9:13]]
3. **to count unclean **(cf. δικαιόω): [[Act.10.15; 11.9|Act.10:15 11:9]].†
_SYN._: βεβηλόω. Thayer (see word κ.) mentions that Winer _Notes_ the accuracy whereby the Jews are said to use κ. in addressing Jews, [[Act.21.28|Act.21:28]], and β. when speaking to Felix, 24:6 (Cremer, 362) (AS)

G2807.def:
**κλείς**, -δός Att.. accusative, κλεῖν, later -εῖδα, pl., κλεῖδες, -ας, contr., -εῖς, ἡ,
[in LXX for מַפְתֵּחַ, [[Isa.22.22|Isa.22:22]], al. ;]
a key. Fig., τ. βασιλείας τ. οὐρανῶν, [[Mat.16.19|Mat.16:19]] τ. γνώσεως, [[Luk.11.52|Luk.11:52]] of David (cf. LXX, l.with), [[Rev.3.7|Rev.3:7]] τ. θανάτου κ. τ. ᾅδου, [[Rev.1.18|Rev.1:18]] τ. ἀβύσσαυ, [[Rev.20.1|Rev.20:1]] τ. φρέατος τῆς ἀ., [[Rev.9.1|Rev.9:1]]†
(AS)

G2853.def:
**κολλάω**, -ῶ
(κόλλα, glue), [in LXX chiefly for דָּבַק ;]
1. to glue or cement together.
2. Generally, to unite, to join firmly. Pass., **to cleave to, join **(oneself to): with dative of person(s), [[Mat.19.5|Mat.19:5]](LXX), [[Luk.10.11; 15.15|Luk.10:11 15:15]], [[Act.5.13|Act.5:13]] (but see Field, _Notes_, 118) [[Act.9.26; 10.28|Act.9:26 10:28]] (see Field, l.with) [[Act.17.34|Act.17:34]] τ. πόρνῃ, [[1Co.6.16|1Co.6:16]] τ. Κυρίῳ, [[1Co.6.17|1Co.6:17]] with dative of thing(s), ἅρματι, [[Act.8.29|Act.8:29]] τ. ἀγαθῴ, [[Rom.12.9|Rom.12:9]] of sins joining together, ἄχρι τ. οὐρανοῦ, [[Rev.18.5|Rev.18:5]], of dust, [[Luk.10.11|Luk.10:11]] (cf. τροσ-κολλάω).†
(AS)

G2855.def:
**κολλυβιστής**, -οῦ, ὁ
(κόλλυβος, a small coin, a rate of exchange),
**a money-changer**: [[Mat.21.12|Mat.21:12]], [[Mrk.11.15|Mrk.11:15]], [[Jhn.2.15|Jhn.2:15]] (of. κερματιοτής).†
(AS)

G2818.def:
**κληρο-νόμος**, -ου, ὁ
(κλῆρος, νέμομαι, to possess) [in LXX: [[Jdg.18.7|Jdg.18:7]], [[2Sa.14.7|2Ki.14:7]], [[Mic.1.15|Mic.1:15]], [[Jer.8.10|Jer.8:10]] (יָרַשׁ), [[Sir.23.22|Sir.23:22]] * ;]
1. (as in cl.) an heir: [[Mat.21.38|Mat.21:38]], [[Mrk.12.7|Mrk.12:7]], [[Luk.20.14|Luk.20:14]], [[Gal.4.1|Gal.4:1]]; of those who as sons of God inherit the privileges of the Messianic Kingdom; of Christ himself, [[Heb.1.2|Heb.1:2]] of Abraham, [[Rom.4.13-14;|Rom.4:13-14]] of Christians, [[Rom.8.17|Rom.8:17]], [[Gal.3.29|Gal.3:29]], [[Tit.3.7|Tit.3:7]], [[Jas.2.5|Jas.2:5]].
2. (As in LXX: Jg, Mi, Je, ll. with) a possessor: [[Heb.6.17; 11.7|Heb.6:17 11:7]] (Cremer, 359 f.).†
(AS)

G2817.def:
**κληρονομία**, -ας, ἡ
(κληρονόμος) [in LXX chiefly for נַחֲלָה, also for יְרֻשָּׁה, etc. ;]
prop., **an inherited property, an inheritance**: [[Mat.21.38|Mat.21:38]], [[Mrk.12.7|Mrk.12:7]], [[Luk.12.13; 20.14|Luk.12:13 20:14]]; in general, **a possession, inheritance**: [[Act.7.5|Act.7:5]], [[Heb.11.8|Heb.11:8]]; of the Messianic Kingdom and its blessings, [[Act.20.32|Act.20:32]], [[Gal.3.18|Gal.3:18]], [[Col.3.24|Col.3:24]], [[Eph.1.14, 18; 5.5|Eph.1:14, 18 5:5]], [[Heb.9.15|Heb.9:15]], [[1Pe.1.4|1Pe.1:4]].†
(AS)

G2867.def:
**κονιάω**, -ῶ
(κονία, dust, lime), [in LXX: [[Deu.27.2|Deu.27:2]], 4 (שִׂיד), [[Pro.21.9|Pro.21:9]] * ;]
**to plaster or whiten over**: of tombs, [[Mat.23.27|Mat.23:27]] figuratively, of a hypocrite, [[Act.23.3|Act.23:3]]†
(AS)

G2844.def:
**κοινωνός**, -ή, -όν
(κοινός), [in LXX: [[Pro.28.24|Pro.28:24]], [[Isa.1.23|Isa.1:23]] (חָבֵר), [[Mal.2.14|Mal.2:14]] (חֲבֶרֶת), [[Est.8.13|Est.8:13]], al. ;]
1. as adj., = κοινός.
2. As subst., ὁ, ἡ κ.,
(a) **a partner, associate, companion**: [[2Co.8.23|2Co.8:23]], Phm 17; with dative of person(s), [[Luk.5.10|Luk.5:10]] with genitive of person(s), [[Heb.10.33|Heb.10:33]] id. before ἐν, [[Mat.23.30|Mat.23:30]]
(b) **a partaker, sharer**: with genitive of thing(s), [[1Co.10.18; 10.20|1Co.10:18 10:20]], [[2Co.1.7|2Co.1:7]], [[1Pe.5.1|1Pe.5:1]], [[2Pe.1.4|2Pe.1:4]] (see Deiss., BS, 368 n2).†
(AS)

G2856.def:
**κολοβόω**, -ῶ
(κολοβός, docked), [in LXX: [[2Sa.4.12|2Ki.4:12]] (קָצַץ pi.) * ;]
to cut off, amputate (LXX), **hence, to curtail, shorten**: [[Mat.24.22|Mat.24:22]], [[Mrk.13.20|Mrk.13:20]].†
(AS)

G2865.def:
**κομίζω **
[in LXX for נָשָׂא, etc. ;]
1. to take care of.
2. to carry off safe.
3. to carry off as booty.
4. **to bear or carry**: [[Luk.7.37|Luk.7:37]] Mid., to bear for oneself, hence,
(a) **to receive**: [[Heb.10.36; 11.13, 39|Heb.10:36 11:13, 39]], [[1Pe.1.9; 5.4|1Pe.1:9 5:4]], [[2Pe.2.13|2Pe.2:13]];
(b) **to receive back, recover **(in cl. so also act.): [[Mat.25.27|Mat.25:27]], [[Heb.11.19|Heb.11:19]]; metaphorically, of requital, [[2Co.5.10|2Co.5:10]], [[Col.3.25|Col.3:25]]; παρὰ Κυρίου, [[Eph.6.8|Eph.6:8]] (cf. ἐκ-, συν-κομίζω).†
(AS)

G2851.def:
**κόλασις**, -εως, ἡ
(κολάζω), [in LXX: [[Ezk.14.3-7; 18.30; 44.12|Eze.14:3-7 18:30 44:12]], (מִכְשׁוֹל) [[Ezk.43.11|Eze.43:11]], λαμβάνειν τὴν κ. (כָּלַם ni.); [[Wis.11.13; 16.2, 24; 19.4|Wis.11:13 16:2, 24 19:4]], [[Jer.18.20, 2-4|Jer.18:20, 2-4]] Mac.5 * ;]
**correction, penalty, punishment**: [[Mat.25.46|Mat.25:46]], [[1Jn.4.18|1Jn.4:18]].†
_SYN._: τιμωρία, requital. Arist. distinguishes between κ . as that which, being disciplinary, has reference to the sufferer, and τ. as that which, being penal, has reference to the satisfaction of him who inflicts (see Thayer, see word κ., and cf. Tr., _Syn._, § vii). But in late Gk. especially, the distinction is not always maintained (see reff. in Thayer) (AS)

G2873.def:
**κόπος**, -ου, ὁ
(κόπτω) [in LXX chiefly for עָמָל, also for אָוֶן, etc. ;]
1. a striking, beating (in [[Jer.45.3|Jer.45:3]] = κοπετός)
2. **laborious toil, trouble**: [[Jhn.4.38|Jhn.4:38]], [[1Co.3.8; 15.58|1Co.3:8 15:58]], [[1Th.3.5|1Th.3:5]]; κ. τ. ἀγάπης, [[1Th.1.3|1Th.1:3]] ἔργα καὶ κ., [[Rev.2.2|Rev.2:2]] κ. καὶ μόχθος, [[2Co.11.27|2Co.11:27]], [[1Th.2.9|1Th.2:9]], [[2Th.3.8|2Th.3:8]]; pl., ἐν κ., [[2Co.6.5; 10.15; 11.23|2Co.6:5 10:15 11:23]]; ἐκ τ. κ., [[Rev.14.13|Rev.14:13]] κόπονς (-ον) παρέχειν (in cl. more frequently π. πράγματα, πονον), with dative of person(s), [[Mat.26.10|Mat.26:10]], [[Mrk.14.6|Mrk.14:6]], [[Luk.11.7; 18.5|Luk.11:7 18:5]], [[Gal.6.17|Gal.6:17]].†
_SYN._: μόλθος, labour; πόνος (which see), toil, painful effort; in cl., "π. gives prominence to the effort (work as requiring force), κ. to the fatigue, μ. (chiefly poetic) to the hardship" (Thayer, see word κ.) (AS)

G2852.def:
**κολαφίζω**
(κόλαφος = Att.., κόνδυλοι, the knuckles, the closed fist)
**to strike with the fist, to buffet**: [[Mat.26.67|Mat.26:67]], [[Mrk.14.65|Mrk.14:65]], [[2Co.12.7|2Co.12:7]]; pass., [[1Co.4.11|1Co.4:11]], [[1Pe.2.20|1Pe.2:20]].†
(AS)

G2878.def:
**κορβάν** (Rec., T, -βᾶν), indecl. (Heb. קׇרְבָּן),
**an offering, a gift offered to God**: [[Mrk.7.11|Mrk.7:11]] (cf. κορβανᾶς).†
(AS)

G2847.def:
**κόκκινος**, -η, -ον
(κόκκος, as used of the "berry" of the ilex coccifera, see _DB_, iv, 416), [in LXX for תּוֹלָע, תּוֹלָע, שָׁנִי, [[Exo.25.4|Exo.25:4]], [[Gen.38.23|Gen.38:23]], [[Isa.1.18|Isa.1:18]], al. ;]
**scarlet**: [[Mat.27.28|Mat.27:28]], [[Heb.9.19|Heb.9:19]], [[Rev.17.3|Rev.17:3]]; neut., without substantive, of clothing, [[Rev.17.4; 18.12, 16|Rev.17:4 18:12, 16]],†
(AS)

G2819.def:
**κλῆρος**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for נַחֲלָה גּוֹרָל ;]
**a lot**;
(a) **that which is cast or drawn**: [[Mat.27.35|Mat.27:35]], [[Mrk.15.24|Mrk.15:24]], [[Luk.23.34|Luk.23:34]], [[Jhn.19.24|Jhn.19:24]]" (LXX), [[Act.1.26|Act.1:26]]
(b) **that which is obtained by casting**: [[Act.1.17; 8.21|Act.1:17 8:21]]; of a part in the Kingdom of God (cf. Wis 55), [[Act.26.18|Act.26:18]], [[Col.1.12|Col.1:12]]; pl. of the "cure" of a presbyter, [[1Pe.5.3|1Pe.5:3]] (see _ICC_, in l).†
(AS)

G2895.def:
**κράβαττος** (Rec. κράββατος), ου, ὁ
(a Macedonian word, = Lat. grabatus, cl. σκίμπους), [in Aquila.: [[Amo.3.12|Amo.3:12]] * ;]
**a camp bed, pallet**: [[Mrk.2.4, 9; 2.11-12; 6.55|Mrk.2:4, 9 2:11-12 6:55]], [[Jhn.5.8-11|Jhn.5:8-11]], [[Act.5.15; 9.33|Act.5:15 9:33]] (see Swete, _Mk._, 24, and cf. κλίνη).†
(AS)

G2891.def:
**κούμ** (Tr., txt., κοῦμ, Rec. κοῦμι) (Heb. imperat. masc., used as an interjection, קוּם),
**koum **(arise): [[Mrk.5.41|Mrk.5:41]]†
(AS)

G2839.def:
**κοινός**, -ή, -όν
[in LXX: [[Pro.1.14|Pro.1:14]] (אֶחָד) [[Pro.21.9; 25.24|Pro.21:9 25:24]] (חֶבֶר), [[Wis.7.3|Wis.7:3]], al. ;]
1. **common **(general; = Lat. communis): [[Act.2.44; 4.32|Act.2:44 4:32]]; κ. πίστις, [[Tit.1.4|Tit.1:4]] σωτηρία, [[Jude.3|Ju 3]]
2. **common **(ordinary; = vulgaris); hence in LXX ([[1Ma.1.47|1Ma.1:47]], al.) and NT, **unhallowed, unclean **(cl., βέβηλος, which see): [[Mrk.7.2|Mrk.7:2]], 5, [[Act.10.14, 28; 11.8|Act.10:14, 28 11:8]], [[Rom.14.14|Rom.14:14]], [[Heb.10.29|Heb.10:29]], [[Rev.21.27|Rev.21:27]].†
(AS)

G2826.def:
**κλινίδιον**, -ου, τό
dimin. of κλίνη,
**a conch**: [[Luk.5.19, 24|Luk.5:19, 24]] (cf. κλενάριον).†
(AS)

G2859.def:
**κόλπος**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for חֵיק ;]
1. prop., **the bosom**: [[Jhn.13.23|Jhn.13:23]] fig., of close association, ἐν (εἰς τὸν) τοῖς κ. Ἀβραάμ, [[Luk.16.22-23|Luk.16:22-23]] (cf. [[4Ma.13.16|4Ma.13:16]]); ὁ ὢν εἰς τὸν κ. τ. πατρός, [[Jhn.1.18|Jhn.1:18]]
2. The bosom or fold of a loose garment falling over a girdle, used as a pocket, hence figuratively, εἰς τὸν κ. [[Isa.65.6|Isa.65:6]], [[Jer.32.18|Jer.32:18]] : [[Luk.6.38|Luk.6:38]]
3. **A bosom-like hollow, as a bay or gulf**: [[Act.27.39|Act.27:39]]†
(AS)

G2830.def:
**κλύδων**, -ωνος, ὁ
(κλύζω, of the sea, to wash over), [in LXX: [[Jon.1.4|Jon.1.4]] [[Jon.1.12|Jon.1.12]] (סַעַר), al. ;]
**a billow, surge**: [[Luk.8.24|Luk.8:24]], [[Jas.1.6|Jas.1:6]].†
_SYN._: κῦμα, a wave (AS)

G2828.def:
**κλισία**, -ας, ή
(κλίνω), [in LXX: [[3Ma.6.31|3Ma.6:31]] A* ;]
1. **a place for reclining**; hence,
(a) **a hut**;
(b) **an easy chair**;
(with) a couch.
2. **a company reclining**: pl., [[Luk.9.14|Luk.9:14]] (cf. FlJ, _Ant._, xii, 2, 12)
(AS)

G2845.def:
**κοίτη**, -ης, ἡ (in Hom., κοῖτος)
[in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁכָּב, also for שְׁכָבָה, etc. ;]
**a bed**: [[Luk.11.7|Luk.11:7]] esp. the marriage-bed: κ. ἀμίαντος, [[Heb.13.4|Heb.13:4]] κ. ἔχειν, of a woman conceiving, [[Rom.9.10|Rom.9:10]] (cf. peculiar phrases in LXX, [[Lev.15.18|Lev.15:18]], al.); of illicit intercourse, pl., [[Rom.13.13|Rom.13:13]]†
(AS)

G2874.def:
**κοπρία**, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for אַשְׁפֹּת ;]
a dung hill ([[1Ki.2.8|1Ki.2:8]], [[Psa.113.7|Psa.113:7]] al.): [[Luk.14.35|Luk.14:35]].†
κόπριον, -ου, τό,
[in LXX (pl.): [[Jer.25.33|Jer.25:33]] (דֹּמֶן), [[Sir.22.2|Sir.22:2]], [[1Ma.2.62|1Ma.2:62]] * ;]
**= κόπρος, dung**: pl., [[Luk.13.8|Luk.13:8]] (WH, mg., κόφινον κοπρίων).†
(AS)

G2884.def:
**κόρος**, -ου, ὁ
(Heb. כֹּר), [in LXX: [[Lev.27.16|Lev.27:16]], [[Num.11.32|Num.11:32]], [[Ezk.45.13|Eze.45:13]] (חֹמֶר); more freq., [[2Ch.27.5|2Ch.27:5]], al.(כֹּר) ;]
**a cor, a Hebrew measure **(AV, RV, measure): [[Luk.16.7|Luk.16:7]]†
(AS)

G2897.def:
**κραιπάλη**
(κρεπάλη, WH), -ης, ἡ (cf. κραιπαλάω for שִׁכּוֹר, [[Isa.24.20; 29.9|Isa.24:20 29:9]])
**drunken nausea **(EV, surfeiting): [[Luk.21.34|Luk.21:34]]†
_SYN._: κῶμος, revelling; μέθη, drunkeness; οἰνοφλυγία, a debauch; πότος, a drinking bout (see Tr., _Syn._, § lxi). (AS)

G2866.def:
**κομψός**, -ή, -όν
(κομέω, to take care of),
**well-dressed, elegant, fine**; compar. neut., κομψότερον ἔχειν (cf. κόμψως ἔχειν, Epict., and colloq. Eng., "to be doing finely"): [[Jhn.4.52|Jhn.4:52]]†
(AS)

G2861.def:
**κολυμβήθρα**, -ας, ἡ
(κολνμβάω), [in LXX for בְּרֵכָה, [[2Ki.18.27|4Ki.18:27]], al. ;]
**a swimming pool, pool**: [[Jhn.5.2, 4; 5.7; 9.7|Jhn.5:2, 4 5:7 9:7]].†
(AS)

G2814.def:
**κλῆμα**, -τος, τό
(κλάω), [in LXX chiefly for זְמוֹרָה, דָּלִיָּה, [[Ezk.15.2; 17.6-7|Eze.15:2 17:6-7]], al. ;]
**a vine-twig, vine-branch**: [[Jhn.15.2, 4-6|Jhn.15:2, 4-6]].†
(AS)

G2832.def:
**Κλωπᾶς**, -ᾶ, ὁ (Aram.; on the original, see Lft., _Gal._, 267 f.),
**Clopas**: [[Jhn.19.25|Jhn.19:25]]†
(AS)

G2842.def:
**κοινωνία**, -ας, ἡ
(κοινωνός), [in LXX: [[Lev.6.2|Lev.6:2]] (יָד תְּשׂוּמֶת), [[Wis.8.18|Wis.8:18]], [[3Ma.4.6|3Ma.4:6]] * ;]
1. **fellowship, communion**: [[Act.2.42|Act.2:42]], [[2Co.6.14|2Co.6:14]], [[Php.1.5|Php.1:5]]; τ. υἱοῦ, [[1Co.1.9|1Co.1:9]] τ. αἵματος, σώματος Χρ., [[1Co.10.10|1Co.10:10]] : παθημάτων αὐτσῦ, [[Php.3.10|Php.3:10]] τ. πνεύματος, [[2Co.13.13|2Co.13:13]], [[Php.2.1|Php.2:1]]; δεξιὰς κοινωνίας, [[Gal.2.9|Gal.2:9]] τ. πίστεώς σου, Phm 6; before μετὰ: τ. πατρός, [[1Jn.1.3|1Jn.1:3]] [[Jhn.1.6|Jn 1:6]]; ἡμῶν, ἀλλήλων, [[1Jn.1.3|1Jn.1:3]] [[Jhn.1.7|Jn 1:7]].
2. **contribution **(as outcome of fellowship): [[Rom.15.26|Rom.15:26]], [[2Co.8.4; 9.13|2Co.8:4 9:13]], [[Heb.13.6|Heb.13:6]] (cf. Art. Communion, _DB_, i, 460 ff.; MM, _Exp._, xv).†
(AS)

G2849.def:
**κολάζω**
(κόλος, docked), [in LXX: [[Dan.6.12|Dan.6:12]] (13) (no _Heb._), I [[Est.8.24|Est.8:24]], [[Wis.3.4|Wis.3:4]] (and freq.), [[1Ma.7.7|1Ma.7:7]], al. ;]
1. to curtail, dock, prune.
2. to check, restrain.
3. **to chastise, correct, punish**: pass., [[2Pe.2.9|2Pe.2:9]] mid., cause to be punished ([[3Ma.7.3|3Ma.7:3]]): [[Act.4.21|Act.4:21]].†
(AS)

G2870.def:
**κοπετός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(κόπτω, mid.), [in LXX chiefly for מִסְפֵּד ;]
= cl. κομμός, a beating of the head and breast, **lamentation**: before ἐπί with dative of person(s), [[Act.8.2|Act.8:2]]†
(AS)

G2804.def:
**Κλαύδιος**, -ου, ὁ
**Claudius**;
1. **the Emperor**: [[Act.11.28; 18.2|Act.11:28 18:2]].
2. A military tribune, C. Lysias: [[Act.23.26|Act.23:26]]†
(AS)

G2846.def:
**κοιτών**, -ῶνος, ὁ
(κοίτη = Att.., δωμότιον, see Kennedy, _Sources_, 40), [in LXX chiefly for חֶדֶר, [[2Ki.4.7|2Ki.4:7]], [[Jol.2.16|Jol.2:16]] I [[Est.3.3|Est.3:3]], al. ;]
**a bed-chamber**; ὁ ἐπὶ τοῦ κ., **a chamberlain**: [[Act.12.20|Act.12:20]]†
(AS)

G2862.def:
**κολωνία ** (Rec. -ώνια), -ας, ἡ
(Lat. colonic),
**a colony**: [[Act.16.12|Act.16:12]] (see Lft., Phi., 50 f.).†
(AS)

G2881.def:
**κορίνθιος**, -α, -ον
**Corinthian**; as subst., ὁ Κ., **a Corinthian**: [[Act.18.8; 27.1-44|Act.18:8 27:1-44]] (WH, txt., R, omit), [[2Co.6.11|2Co.6:11]] 1Co, 2Co, tit.†
(AS)

G2834.def:
**Κνίδος**, -ου, ἡ
Cnidus, a city (and peninsula) on S.W. coast of Asia Minor: [[Act.27.7|Act.27:7]]†
(AS)

G2802.def:
**Καῦδα** (TR, mg., Κλαῦδα; Rec. Κλαύδή), ἡ,
**Cauda, Clauda, an island near Crete**: [[Act.27.16|Act.27:16]]†
(AS)

G2880.def:
**κορέννυμι**
(κόρος, surfeit), [in Symmachus.: [[Psa.22.27|Psa.22:27]], Al, [[Psa.103.5|Psa.103:5]] * ;]
**to satisfy**: pass., τροφῆς, [[Act.27.38|Act.27:38]] metaphorically, of spiritual things, [[1Co.4.8|1Co.4:8]]†
(AS)

G2893.def:
**κουφίζω**
(κοῦφος, light), [in LXX: [[Exo.18.22|Exo.18:22]], [[Jon.1.5|Jon.1.5]], al. (קָלַל hi.), [[Est.5.1|Est.5:1]], al. ;]
1. intrans., to be light (poetic chiefly).
2. **to lighten, make light**: with accusative, [[Act.27.38|Act.27:38]]†
(AS)

G2860.def:
**κολυμβάω**, -ῶ
[in AI.: [[Isa.25.11|Isa.25:11]] * ;]
**to dive, plunge into the sea**: [[Act.27.43|Act.27:43]] (cf. ἐκ-κολνμβάω).†
(AS)

G2841.def:
**κοινωνέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[2Ch.20.35|2Ch.20:35]], [[Job.34.8|Job.34:8]], [[Ecc.9.4|Ecc.9:4]] (חָבַר), [[Pro.1.11|Pro.1:11]], [[Wis.6.23|Wis.6:23]], [[Sir.13.1|Sir.13:1]], al. ;]
to have a share of, go shares in (something) with (some one), **take part in**: with genitive of thing(s) (as usually in cl., so Pr, l.with), [[Heb.2.14|Heb.2:14]] with dative of thing(s), [[Rom.12.13; 15.27|Rom.12:13 15:27]], [[1Ti.5.22|1Ti.5:22]], [[1Pe.4.13|1Pe.4:13]], [[2Jn.11|2Jn.11]]; with dative of person(s), before εἰς, [[Php.4.15|Php.4:15]] ἐν, [[Gal.6.6|Gal.6:6]] (cf. συν-κοινωνέω).†
(AS)

G2824.def:
**κλίμα**, -τος, τό
(κλίνω) [in LXX: [[Jdg.20.2|Jdg.20:2]] A (פִּנָּה)* ;]
1. an inclination, slope, esp. the slope from the equator to the pole (Arist).
2. **a region **(Polyb., al.): pl., [[Rom.15.23|Rom.15:23]], [[2Co.11.10|2Co.11:10]], [[Gal.1.21|Gal.1:21]].†
(AS)

G2820.def:
**κληρόω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[1Sa.14.41|1Ki.14:41]] (לָכַד ni.), [[Est.4.11|Est.4:11]] A (קָרָא ni.), [[Isa.17.11|Isa.17:11]] * ;]
1. to cast lots.
2. to choose by lot.
3. **to assign by lot, assign a portion**: pass., ἐν ᾧ καὶ ἐκληρώθημεν, [[Eph.1.11|Eph.1:11]] (on the various interpretations, see _ICC_; AR; Ellic., in l).†
(AS)

G2831.def:
**κλυδωνίζομαι**
(κλύδων), [in LXX: [[Isa.57.20|Isa.57:20]] (גָּרַשׁ)* ;]
**to be tossed by waves**; metaphorically, **to be tossed like waves **(cf. FlJ, _Ant._, ix, 11, 3): [[Eph.4.14|Eph.4:14]]†
(AS)

G2888.def:
**κοσμοκράτωρ**, -ορος, ὁ
(κόσμος, κρατέω),
1. in Orphic hymns, al. (see AR, _Eph._, l.with), a ruler of the whole world (and so in Rabbinic writings: קוֺזמוֺקְרָטוֺר).
2. **a ruler of this world **(in contrast to παντο κράτωρ): οἱ κ. τ. σκότους τούτου, the rulers of this dark world, [[Eph.6.12|Eph.6:12]]†
(AS)

G2857.def:
**Κολοσσαί**
(so in cl.; -ασσαί, Rec., LTr.), -ῶν, αἰ
**Colossæ, a city on the Lycus in Phrygia**: [[Col.1.2|Col.1:2]]†
(AS)

G2887.def:
**κόσμιος**, -ον (in cl. -α, -ον),
(κόσμος), [in LXX: [[Ecc.12.9|Ecc.12:9]] (תָּקַן)* ;]
**orderly, decent, modest**: [[1Ti.2.9|1Ti.2:9]] (WH, mg., -ίως, which see) [[1Ti.3.2|1Ti.3:2]]†
(AS)

G2843.def:
**κοινωνικός**, -ή, -όν
(κοινωνία),
1. sociable.
2. **ready to com­municate or impart **(R, mg., ready to sympathize, see Field, _Notes_, 213 f.): [[1Ti.6.18|1Ti.6:18]]†
(AS)

G2833.def:
**κνήθω**
(late form of κνάω),
1. to scratch.
2. **to tickle**; pass., **to itch**: [[2Ti.4.3|2Ti.4:3]]†
(AS)

G2886.def:
**κοσμικός**, -ή, -όν
(κόσμος)
1. pertaining to the world or universe.
2. of this world, earthly. [[Heb.9.1|Heb.9:1]]
3. **In ethical sense, worldly**: ἐπιθυμίαι, [[Tit.2.12|Tit.2:12]]†
(AS)

G2871.def:
**κοπή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(κόπτω), [in LXX: [[Gen.14.17|Gen.14:17]], [[Jos.10.20|Jos.10:20]] (נָכָה hi., מַכָּה), [[Deu.28.25|Deu.28:25]] (נָגַף), [[Jdt.15.7|Jdth.15:7]] * ;]
1. in cl., a stroke, a pounding (as in a mortar).
2. **In LXX, a smiting in battle**: [[Heb.7.1|Heb.7:1]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G2811.def:
**κλέος**, -ους, τό
[in LXX: [[Job.28.22|Job.28:22]] (שֵׁמַע) [[Job.30.8|Job.30:8]] * ;]
1. a rumour, report.
2. **good report, fame, glory**: [[1Pe.2.20|1Pe.2:20]]†
(AS)

G2854.def:
**κολλούριον**
(TTr., κολλύ-, the more usual form), -ου, τό (dimin. of κολλύρα = κόλλιξ, a coarse bread roll), [in LXX: [[1Ki.12.24|3Ki.12:24]] hil B* ;]
1. a small bread roll (LXX, ll. with).
2. (Usually in pl., LS, see word) an eye salve shaped like a roll: [[Rev.3.18|Rev.3:18]]†
(AS)

G2809.def:
**κλέμμα**, -τος, τό
(κλέπτω), [in LXX: [[Gen.31.39|Gen.31:39]], [[Exo.22.3-4|Exo.22:3-4]] (2-3) (גָּנַב, גְּנֵבָה)* ;]
1. a thing stolen (Arist., LXX)
2. **= κλοπή, theft **(Plato, al.): pl., [[Rev.9.21|Rev.9:21]]†
(AS)
